plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the Vaultkey marketing and pricing system, focusing on interactive pricing components, navigation, responsive layout shifts, and accessibility of controls.
plan.summary: The run will start by exploring the landing page (index.html), validating navigation, layout, and mobile responsiveness. It will then transition to the pricing page (pricing.html) to deeply test the billing toggle, the Business per-seat slider/input, and the FAQ accordion. Finally, it will verify the feature comparison table and ensure all critical states are checked on both desktop and mobile viewports.
assumptions: The site is a static front-end with no backend, so form submissions and authentication flows will not actually process.
The Business per-seat slider and number input are bi-directionally linked and should update the price dynamically.
The FAQ accordion expands and collapses sections without routing to a new page.
Navigation links pointing to '#' (Security, Enterprise, Help, Sign in, Get Vaultkey, Download free) will not navigate away but may trigger anchor scrolls or no-ops.
risk_hotspots: Business per-seat slider and linked number input synchronization (pricing.html)
Yearly/Monthly billing toggle state and price recalculation across all plans (pricing.html)
Small tap targets for navigation links identified in the prescan (especially on mobile viewports)
FAQ accordion keyboard accessibility and state management (pricing.html)
Feature comparison table readability and horizontal scrolling on mobile viewports (pricing.html)

phases.title: Landing Page Exploration
phases.objective: Validate the layout, content, and navigation of the primary landing page.
key_checks: Verify hero section renders correctly with dual CTAs
Click 'See plans →' and 'See pricing →' links to ensure they route to pricing.html
Check faux app screenshot section for layout integrity
Validate trust strip and why-cards layout
Test all '#' href links (Security, Enterprise, etc.) for expected behavior
exit_criteria: All visible links on index.html have been clicked
Page structure and content have been fully observed

phases.title: Pricing Page Core Interactions
phases.objective: Deeply test the primary interactive pricing components on the pricing page.
key_checks: Toggle between 'Yearly' and 'Monthly' billing and verify price updates for Personal, Family, and Business plans
Interact with the Business per-seat slider across its range (3-200) and verify linked number input updates
Type values into the Business number input and verify slider updates
Validate that volume pricing tiers update correctly based on seat count
Click 'Get Personal', 'Start free 30-day trial', and 'Start 14-day trial' buttons
exit_criteria: Billing toggle has been switched multiple times
Slider dragged to minimum, middle, and maximum values
Number input tested with boundary values (3, 25, 200)
Price calculations observed for all states

phases.title: Pricing Page Content & Accordion
phases.objective: Validate the feature comparison table and FAQ accordion interactions.
key_checks: Expand and collapse multiple FAQ accordion items
Verify only one or multiple FAQ items can be open simultaneously
Scroll through the 25-row grouped feature comparison table
exit_criteria: At least 3 FAQ items expanded and collapsed
Feature comparison table fully scrolled and observed

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness Checks
phases.objective: Re-evaluate critical flows and layouts on a mobile viewport to identify responsive issues.
key_checks: Check navigation menu behavior on mobile (hamburger menu or stacked links)
Validate hero section and CTAs stacking on mobile
Test Business per-seat slider/input on mobile viewport
Check feature comparison table horizontal scrolling or stacking on mobile
Re-verify small tap target issues flagged in prescan
exit_criteria: Both pages viewed on mobile viewport
Critical interactions (toggle, slider, accordion) repeated on mobile
Layout warnings and tap target sizes assessed

coverage_targets.pages: visit all known HTML pages (index.html, pricing.html)
coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible controls: billing toggle, slider, number input, accordion, and all CTAs
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks (pricing toggle, slider, accordion, table scroll) on mobile viewport

notes: Prescan flagged multiple small tap targets on navigation links; pay close attention to these during the mobile phase.
The Business plan slider ranges from 3-200 with 5 pricing tiers; ensure boundary values between tiers (e.g., 24 to 25 seats) correctly trigger price changes.
